name: git_grep_repeat_guard
description: The same `git grep` run_command four times in one task executes once (one approval prompt); the three repeats are blocked with TEKRAR ENGELLENDİ, and the next model turn is forced to answer without tools (tool_choice=none). Old bug: `git grep` was classified as a file-changing command, every run reset the repeat guard, and a REPL session ran the same grep 25+ times per turn.
user_inputs: Worker sınıflarını bul ve kalan işi söyle.
